minimalCurrentCanonical72_75.purpose: Observe the assembled main-app controls and real owner continuation. Retained native tests already prove two captures and the broader diplomacy effects.
sequence: From the main menu, open Campaigns and realms, then World conquest and diplomacy. Set Conquest faction to Deepforge (dwarves) and click Create realm.

Click Attack: Deep Gate Quarry. Use ordinary movement, attack, abilities and any real reinforcement commands to win. Confirm accepted quarry ownership, turn1, active:null, real survivors and Crossroads accessibility before diplomacy.

While the completed quarry scene remains installed, open Missions and realms → World conquest and diplomacy. Select Foreign faction Wild Court (fairies). Set Tribute ore to250 and click Offer tribute; observe accepted treasury/score change. Set Truce turns to2, click Request truce, and observe the temporary truce before clicking Request alliance.

After those decisions, use Saves → Export save to download ordinary SessionFile A, then Missions and realms → World conquest and diplomacy → Export realm profile to download B. Both must precede completed realm import/resume, which retires the battlefield. A.scenarioProfile.profile and B now contain the same capture and diplomacy history.

Use Load realm profile / Import realm profile to import B through the native file input. Reload the page. From Campaigns and realms → World conquest and diplomacy, click Resume saved realm and export restored profile C.

From the restored realm, click Attack: Brass Crossroads and fight using ordinary commands. Export active ordinary SessionFile D through Saves → Export save. Its owner and active journal establish continued deployment into the connected next battle.
minimalCurrentCanonical72_75.diplomacyMath: Quarry combat changes undead relations, so Fairies still have score0 and warPressure0. Tribute250 transfers250 ore from the real player treasury to foreign treasury100→350 and adds50 relation points. Truce requires20 and alliance50. Neither truce nor alliance charges more resources. At turn1, two-turn truce sets truceUntil3; alliance becomes true without deleting that history. Fairies are separate from quarry/crossroads, so both remain attack battles.
minimalCurrentCanonical72_75.funding: Winning quarry sets the real treasury to final battlefield resources plus connected Hearth+Quarry supply:155wood/210ore/18crystal. Use the actual visible bank. The ordinary native strategy trains at most3 Dwarf Thunderlocks at40ore each, leaving enough for tribute250. If other real spending leaves less than250ore, one Wait one turn adds210ore; this is a funding option, not an extra acceptance requirement or synthetic top-up.
smallestSuggestedDownloads: A: completed-quarry ordinary SessionFile AFTER diplomacy and BEFORE completed realm import retires the scene.
B: matching post-quarry/post-diplomacy realm profile, used as the native imported file.
C: re-export of that complete realm after import plus fresh reload/resume.
D: active crossroads ordinary SessionFile after ordinary combat.
minimalCurrentCanonical72_75.comparisons: B and C are equal as complete parsed profiles, including id, worldId, faction, turn, treasury, regions, army, relations, ordered history and active:null. A.scenarioProfile.profile equals B; A.game.version is4, its quarry runtime outcome is won and winner is0. D retains quarry ownership, diplomatic history and profile ID. D.scenarioProfile.profile.active.regionId is crossroads, mode attack, and deployed IDs refer to B survivors. Compare IDs, roles, definitions and veterancy; deployment intentionally heals/repositions survivors and clears combat transients. Real ordinary commands must appear in D’s active journal. Compare actual exports and do not fabricate fields.
minimalCurrentCanonical72_75.secondBattleCompletion: The original requirement says fight connected battles. A second merely opened battlefield is weak evidence; ordinary combat and a current active owner export establish that continuation. The retained admitted conquest test already proves the second capture. A second full canonical win may reuse its result if performed, but is not a new additional gate.
minimalCurrentCanonical72_75.separateOrdinarySaveImport: If the already-authorized shared canonical plan also imports the ordinary SessionFile, import A after C through Import save JSON → Import save, observe Save loaded., then launch Crossroads. A now includes the same diplomacy and will not rewind it. Preserve its paused game and owner. Whole SessionFile equality is unnecessary because replay verification can add derived summaries. This ordinary-save import is supported by the four downloads, but is not a new original72/75 gate.
